'''''Legacy of the Force: Revelation''''' is the eighth novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It is a paperback by [[Karen Traviss]] and was released [[February 26]], [[2008]]. An exclusive hardcover edition of the book was published by the [[Science Fiction Book Club]]. The [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation (abridged audiobook)|audiobook]] is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The cover is of Jacen Solo, now transformed by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as [[Darth Caedus]].
